candidate_as_built.explanation: The grey-green paint is uniform and clean across all views, with sharp edges and clear hardware details visible in the detail block.

candidate_aged.explanation: The aged state shows convincing broad paint retention with irregular edge corrosion and downward rust runs, though the top surface dust appears slightly patchy in the top view.

locker_as_built.explanation: The reference locker presents a clean, consistent grey-green finish with well-defined vents and handles in the front and detail views.

locker_aged.explanation: The aged locker exhibits realistic weathering with significant rust on edges and hardware, matching the brief for a 1000-year sealed environment.

grey-green_paint.observations: The base color is a consistent grey-green across all as-built views, matching the warship steel brief.

bare_hardware.observations: Handles and latches appear as distinct metallic elements in the as-built state, clearly visible in the detail block.

dark_trim.observations: Dark trim is visible along the bottom edges and corners in the as-built views, providing a grounded look.

edge_corrosion.observations: The aged state shows significant rust and corrosion concentrated on edges and corners, particularly in the hero and front views.

rust_runs.observations: Narrow downward rust runs are visible on vertical faces in the aged state, adding to the weathered appearance.

settled_dust.observations: A fine layer of dust is visible on upward-facing surfaces in the aged state, though it appears slightly uneven in the top view.

faded_fabric.observations: No fabric pads are visible in any of the views, so this feature cannot be assessed.

glass_retention.observations: No glass displays are visible in any of the views, so this feature cannot be assessed.

findings: The dust on the top surface in the aged state appears slightly patchy and could be more uniform to better simulate settled dust.
The rust runs on the vertical faces could be slightly more varied in width and intensity to enhance the natural weathering effect.
limitations: The absence of fabric pads and glass displays in the views limits the assessment of those specific material features.

acceptance.rule: candidate aged >= locker aged in this review, numeric gates pass, all four view blocks inspected
